package gateways

import (
	"context"

	models "example.test/gwapp/internal/models/gateways"
	"example.test/gwapp/internal/scope"
)

// Get reads the gateway the path names; the adapter answers not found for a
// gateway the verified tenant cannot see.
func Get(
	ctx context.Context,
	e scope.Execution,
	ports GetPorts,
	in models.GetRequest,
) (models.GatewayInfo, error) {
	return ports.Registry.Get(ctx, e, in)
}
